author: de14fbf8-798b-433e-90b5-81fb6f9113cd
description:
## Requirements:

- OrcaSlicer 2.4.0-beta or higher
- Printer: Bambu Lab A1 mini
- Nozzle: 0.2mm
- Filament: eSUN PLA+ High Speed
- Build Plate: Cool Plate (SuperTack)

## Known issues and Information:

- You may encounter errors when using the profile because certain settings are unavailable - just ignore them. It's because not all features were merged into the stable release of OrcaSlicer. The list of missing features can be found [here](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/issues?q=is%3Aopen%20is%3Apr%2011015%20AND%2013459%20AND%2012151).

- Please set the `Retract amount before wipe` to 100%

- Wall speeds were set to 72 mm/s because this is the minimum speed that gives me a good wall look. For you, it can be different. Please take some time to do the tests.

- If you are using the regular eSUN PLA+, change the 72 mm/s speeds to 54-60 mm/s.

- I still recommend that you use cooling towers

- Resin2FDM supports can give you a lot of micro-stringing

- You still can't send the prints directly from the slicer. You will need to export the sliced plate as a 3MF file and then send it to the printer via Bambu Connect.

- Do not use the [Flow Dynamics Calibration](https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/software/bambu-studio/calibration_pa) feature

- Photos of the minis, printed with this profile, can be found [there](https://www.instagram.com/layered.curiosities).
